title: Parse: Extract requirements from 14.6
description:
Read spec section, extract MUST/SHALL/SHOULD statements, create checklist in task description

## Requirements Extracted from Section 14.6 Time Synchronization

### MUST NOT Requirements

1. **[MUST NOT]** Nodes MUST NOT adopt time from lower stratum sources (line 221-222)
2. **[MUST NOT]** Nodes MUST NOT accept DIO timestamps below their effective epoch floor (line 222-223)  
3. **[MUST NOT]** Constrained nodes MUST NOT originate time-sensitive operations (scheduled check-in, message TTL that requires wall-clock comparison) without valid wall-clock (line 232-233)

### SHOULD Requirements

4. **[SHOULD]** Constrained nodes SHOULD persist replay epoch counter across reboots (increment on boot) (line 230)
5. **[SHOULD]** Border routers SHOULD run NTS client (preferred) or Roughtime client (line 239)
6. **[SHOULD]** Border routers SHOULD validate obtained time against the epoch floor before advertising (line 240)
7. **[SHOULD]** Border routers SHOULD advertise time in DIO with appropriate stratum (line 241)
8. **[SHOULD]** Border routers SHOULD provide NTS/Roughtime proxy for LCI clients (line 242)
9. **[SHOULD]** Border routers SHOULD expose time provider state (source class, validity, age) via CoAP status (line 243)

### MAY Requirements

10. **[MAY]** Nodes receiving DIO with higher stratum than their own MAY adopt that time, subject to epoch floor validation (line 220-221)
11. **[MAY]** Constrained nodes MAY omit absolute timestamps from SenML (use relative t offsets only) (line 231)

### Implicit Requirements (Architecture)

12. **effective_epoch_floor** = max(firmware_build_epoch, board_provision_epoch_if_valid)
13. Time samples below epoch floor are rejected for wall-clock establishment
14. Report wall_clock_valid=false via LCI status until a valid source appears
15. DIO Time Option format: 8 bytes (Type 1B, Length 1B, Stratum 1B, Reserved 1B, Timestamp 4B Unix epoch)

Checklist added to task description for implementation reference.
